story.title: I will be myself!
paragraphs_en: Hi every body! My name is Sundari. I am turning 6 today. Amma said I am old enough to go to school now.
Amma says I will have lots of fun. I hope she is right. I hope I will find new good friends.
When I go to school, Mrs Shila tells all of us to sit down. I go and sit down in the front desk. I love to learn!
I listen to everything Mrs Shila teaches us. Then, she tells us that it is playing time! Yay! I love to play.

I stand up and run outside! I love the fresh air. As I was walking, I heard Mrs Shila call me. She says " Oh Sundari! Do you know the rules? You are not supposed to go out of the class until I tell you to. You disobeyed my rules. Now go to the principal's office! GO!" I feel my cheeks getting red. I did not know the rules!

I was forced to go to the office. I quietly enter the room. Mr Rahul says " Aham. Hi. Why did you come here?" I tell him why I came here. He says " Oh Sundari. Do not worry. Everything will be fine. Here. Take this sheet of paper. It has all the rules. If you read all of them, you will not get in trouble anymore.
I take the sheet of paper and go inside my classroom. All the students looked at me and laughed. Why did I come to school? I do not like it at all! I hate getting laughed at.

I sit down and cry. Nobody likes me! Mr Sharma, our English teacher calls out our names. The paper which Principal gave, tells that when they call your name, we can go out to play. I wait for Mr Sharma to call my name. When he does, I go out. He told us to eat our lunch when we go out.

All the children were playing. How I wish I could play with them. I go and ask Tia if I could play with her. " Tia! Can I please play soccer with you and the others?" Tia said " No! Go away Sundari! We do not want you! Please leave us alone!"
I feel very sad. I just go and sit for lunch. Amma has given Idli for lunch. I eat it and look at the sky. Ahhhhh I wish I had friends.

Then all of us go back to class. Amar was hanging up something on the display board. Everyone went there to see what it is. They looked at it and laughed. Maybe it is something fun! I will go and check!
Ahhhh? It was a funny picture of me! Why do everyone hate me so much? What did I do?

Mr Sharma goes and tells Tia and Amar " Making fun of Sundari is not good. You both go to the principal's office!" Amar and Tia go to the principal's office. Mr Sharma tells me that I should just ignore them.

When I go and sit down, Anika tells me " Oh Sundari! All of us do not like you because you wear so much jewelry! You look ugly with those!" I ignore them and concentrate on my studies. Later it was time to go home.
I run home and throw all my jewelry. Amma rushes and comes and asked me what happened.
I tell Amma everything that happened today. She consoles me. She tells me that what others think does not matter. I just have to be me. I understand Amma. I will be me!
The next day, I wake up early and put on my jewelry. I will be me today.
The next day when I come in, Anika says " Hahaa! Jewelry girl is back!" I just shout back " Aham! Anika! I do not care about what you think. I will be me!"

That day when I was going home, Anika and Rahul came and told me " Sorry Sundari! We were very mean to you all these days. Will you forgive and be our friends?" I was so happy! I forgive them and tell them that I would love to be their friend.

The next day was so good! All of them became my friends and we played together. Then Tia came and asked me if she could have some jewelry. I told them that the next day I would get all of them some jewelry.
I gather up some jewelry to give. I am so happy! I found such good friends.

The next day for Assembly, I was picked. I told everyone about being yourself. Everyone loved it. I also gave the Jewelry. All of them were very happy. Amma was right! Being yourself is very important.

All the students looked at me and laughed.
Why did I come to school?
I do not like it at all!
I hate getting laughed at.
I sit down and cry.
Nobody likes me!
Mr Sharma, our English teacher calls out our names.
The paper which Principal gave, tells that when they call your name, we can go out to play.
I wait for Mr Sharma to call my name.
When he does, I go out.
He told us to eat our lunch when we go out.
All the children were playing.
How I wish I could play with them.
I go and ask Tia if I could play with her.
" Tia! Can I please play soccer with you and the others?" Tia said " No!
Go away Sundari!
We do not want you!
Please leave us alone!"
I feel very sad.
I just go and sit for lunch.
Amma has given Idli for lunch.
I eat it and look at the sky.
Ahhhhh I wish I had friends.
Then all of us go back to class.
Amar was hanging up something on the display board.
Everyone went there to see what it is.
They looked at it and laughed.
Maybe it is something fun!
I will go and check!
Ahhhh? It was a funny picture of me!
Why do everyone hate me so much?
What did I do?
Mr Sharma goes and tells Tia and Amar " Making fun of Sundari is not good.
You both go to the principal's office!" Amar and Tia go to the principal's office.
Mr Sharma tells me that I should just ignore them.
When I go and sit down, Anika tells me " Oh Sundari!
All of us do not like you because you wear so much jewelry!
You look ugly with those!" I ignore them and concentrate on my studies.
Later it was time to go home.
I run home and throw all my jewelry.
Amma rushes and comes and asked me what happened.
I tell Amma everything that happened today.
She consoles me.
She tells me that what others think does not matter.
I just have to be me.
I understand Amma.
I will be me!
The next day, I wake up early and put on my jewelry.
I will be me today.
The next day when I come in, Anika says " Hahaa!
Jewelry girl is back!" I just shout back " Aham!
Anika! I do not care about what you think.
I will be me!"
That day when I was going home, Anika and Rahul came and told me " Sorry Sundari!
We were very mean to you all these days.
Will you forgive and be our friends?" I was so happy!
I forgive them and tell them that I would love to be their friend.
The next day was so good!
All of them became my friends and we played together.
Then Tia came and asked me if she could have some jewelry.
I told them that the next day I would get all of them some jewelry.
I gather up some jewelry to give.
I am so happy!
I found such good friends.
The next day for Assembly, I was picked.
I told everyone about being yourself.
Everyone loved it.
I also gave the Jewelry.
All of them were very happy.
Amma was right!
Being yourself is very important.
